evidence: Agent-visible prompt surface = task/instruction.md + /instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md} (environment/Dockerfile COPY instructions/ and assets/ only). (1) Skill grep recipe run case-insensitively over brief and notes, widened to judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|glm|claude|/tests|sentinel|gate|probe|verifier|grader|grade|oracle|harbor|restart_app|restart_mcp|polish|functional|visual|render|constraints|likert|points|test.sh|app_context|mcp|openrouter|check|pass|fail: only benign hits — instruction.md:13 'please check it yourself the way we'll use it' (requester-voice self-test line, lesson 5), instruction.md:15 'GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database' (template runtime contract, mirrors template integration.md), instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11 'password' (demo credentials the profile expects). No judge, rubric, dimension name, weight, score, test path or tool name appears. (2) Criterion ids: none of the 24 ids (hro_gate_shared, hro_gate_render, hro_intake_restart ... hro_vis_consistency) nor the prefix 'hro_' appear in brief/notes. (3) Probe literals: extracted 83 quoted literals from tests/**/*.md|toml; the only ones present in the public text are the 10 demo emails and Hireops!2026, which check-demo-accounts-agree requires to match. Judge-created values such as J1/J2, 'suffixed message', the restart_app tool, seeded-order quotes (e.g. Greta Lindqvist, Noor's note text) are absent from the brief/notes. seed_data.json contains no probe/sentinel/gate/judge/test markers. (4) Verbatim overlap: no 8-word shingle shared between public text and any tests file; at 6 words only short restatements in scored/functional/judge.toml of public rules ('says the card was changed and', 'its most recent 30 messages oldest of', '30 at a time in order', 'how many are still to come', 'other candidates or their applications or', 'the box is empty and still') — criteria quoting the requirement, not the brief copying criterion text at length. (5) Colderwater lessons checked for every bearing instance: lesson 1/12 (hidden or checklist-shaped requirements mirroring criteria) — no criterion wording or ids mirrored; notes use requester voice with reasons ('We're usually in the middle of something when an update lands', 'Our servers don't always start Node from inside the app folder'). Lesson 5 self-check line names the user's own workflow ('two of us in separate browsers'), not the judge or restart tool. Lesson 13 public internet address: none in brief/notes. Builder-for-grader phrasing: hireops_rules.md:80-81 'so whatever screen or tool sent the move can tell them' and integration.md:16-23 (copy /app, different working directory, locked-down account) reveal that non-UI clients and a relocated run exist, but give a product/deployment reason and name no grader, test path or tool; the deployment facts are runtime contract (rows 4/21 territory), not grader machinery. Plausible-broken-app / conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the prompt lets a model target grader internals (no sentinel to echo, no criterion id to print, no test path to read), and nothing in it would penalise a conforming app that ignores grader concepts. Row 5 is a static text row; no runtime evidence is required, so missing raw-evidence-index records do not affect it.
